surface_name: Video recording with a shared page
title: Videos are missing for most tests when one page is created in beforeAll and reused
symptoms: Only one video file appears for a whole describe block
page.video().path() points to a file that is empty or not yet written
video: 'retain-on-failure' keeps nothing for tests after the first
cause: A video covers the page from creation to close and is written only after the page or context closes. A page shared across tests produces one recording that no single test owns.
fix: Use the per-test page fixture, or record a trace instead of a video for serial suites.
apply:
test('checkout', async ({ page }) => { /* fresh page, own video */ })
// serial suites: use: { trace: 'retain-on-failure' }
affected: Playwright Test, all versions (open issue since 1.22)
